# Vocabulary dependency-injection/v0

Dependency-injection containers: services, the registrations that bind them with a lifetime, the implementations they produce, and the services implementations depend on. Defined in docs/models/dependency-injection-model.md. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/dependency-injection/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/vocabularies/dependency-injection/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/vocabularies/dependency-injection/v0.json).

An extraction follows this vocabulary when its `vocabularies` include it; its `schema` must be `architecture/v0`. The extraction schema applies this one to it.
